geometry.discrete_rule: bounded nonintersecting +/-1-row transitions; actual ribs reserved
geometry.bounds: anchors+5.5*tanh followed by ordered/rib-safe geometric projection

evaluation.split: open development; used during method development
evaluation.selection: Lowest nominal 128x128 silicon peak among candidates jointly admitted on 64x64 and 128x128 in both regimes
evaluation.baseline_per_case: Best of Adam and MMA within each separately reported baseline family

baselines.Standard: One exact Uniform-Parallel start, 600 objective queries per optimizer; legacy geometric decoder
baselines.Matched: Same separated-channel decoder as the neural model; score four analytic starts, then one selected 600-query trajectory per optimizer
baselines.MultiStart: Preserved Stage5.4 references; four starts x600 objective queries per optimizer, older decoder

training.initialization: Backbone transferred from prior checkpoint, geometry and pixel output heads reset

limitations: Reduced depth-averaged Darcy/thermal model; not resolved 3D CFD or device measurements.
The open 16-case set does not establish blind-test generalization.
Gain over Standard includes the geometric representation change; Matched separates this contribution.
No measured complete-system speedup or industrial SOTA claim.
